summary: npm package used as CDN delivery vehicle for browser redirect script
details: Package ships a single browser-only script as its `main` entry that constructs a fullscreen iframe redirecting visitors to https://mfmz.untfwb.cn/H.html. The code references `document` and would throw if loaded in Node. There are no npm lifecycle hooks (no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and no Node-reachable side effects on `require`/`import`. A bundled helper shell script updates the redirect domain, bumps the version, runs `npm publish`, and purges the jsDelivr cache — indicating the package is being used as a CDN distribution channel (via jsDelivr's npm mirror) for a browser redirect payload targeting web page visitors, rather than as a Node library. Installing or requiring the package in a Node/build context does not execute the redirect and does not read installer secrets, fetch remote code, or open a backdoor.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
